name: OWASP_A01_Path_Traversal_Attempt
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" OR sourcetype="nginx:plus:access" | eval uri_decoded=urldecode(uri_path), uri_query_decoded=urldecode(_raw) | regex uri_decoded="(?i)(\.\.\/|\.\.\\|%2e%2e%2f|%2e%2e\/|%2e%2e%5c|%252e%252e)" | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(uri_path) as targeted_paths by src_ip, http_user_agent, status | where count >= 3
description: Detects path traversal directory sequence injection in HTTP requests.
